title: ACL Reconstruction
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Assess the effusion, since a persistent or a recurrent effusion after the early weeks is a finding rather than a stage.
Measure the range, recording the extension first, because an extension deficit after a reconstruction is the deficit that matters.
Assess the quadriceps bulk and the ability to hold the leg straight, since quadriceps recovery governs the function.
Assess the rotational control, since a graft can restrain the anterior translation and leave the rotation.
